lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Commander,

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: about the soda in the fridge...
Have you drank it all?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: No no.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: If you're talking about the one

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I usually drink,

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I just restocked it recently.
Aren't all sodas pretty much the same?
Isn't there more to your life than just soda?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: How could you utter such blasphemy?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: You could at least try to be more considerate.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: "Oh, great wise Anis, please educate me in the ways of all things soda."

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Something like that.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: "The way you're talking leads me to believe that there must be a new flavor of soda out?"

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Or that.
If I did say one of those things, what would your reply be?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Hehehehehe!

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Something along those lines, maybe?
Oh, great wise Anis, please educate me in the ways of all things soda.
The way you're talking leads me to believe that there must be a new flavor of soda out?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Hahahaha!

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: It was already funny when I imagined it in my mind, but actually hearing you say it was even funnier.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Anyways,

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: listen up.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: You know that soda from the one company that I'm always drinking?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I was getting tired of it,

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: so I started looking around,

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: and it turns out that there are all sorts of sodas around!

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Did you know this?
All sorts of sodas?  Like beer?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Pssh, you've gotta broaden your horizons, Commander.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Judging from my research, these other sodas don't use artificially carbonated water,

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: but harvest it from a natural spring where carbonated water flows naturally!
Oooh, sounds interesting.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I know, right!?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: How about you and I check it out together?
Sounds good.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Okay, you promised! Don't forget!

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I'll check out where it's located.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I'll go see what date works best for us to take a little excursion.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: You've gotta take that day off, no matter what!
Okay, okay.
